name: real-app-mixed
_comment: Mixed scenario on FrameConsole (--host <sender IP>): quality mix source / 720p / 480p over the app's shared on-demand qualities (/<path>/720p/whep, /<path>/480p/whep; the broadcast must offer both renditions, otherwise the run stops with quality-not-offered before stage 10), churn (1 leave + 1 re-join per second, re-joins stop when the hold ends), chat for everyone, 10% DVR readers (skipped and recorded when /info says dvr: false). Every quality is judged against its own ingest rate from /api/stats (paths screen-01, screen-01/720p, screen-01/480p). Hold 45 s per stage (fast iteration). Traffic cap 20 GB covers the planned stages (~4 GB at the mix rate).
